nodes.source_text: The HER performance of Tm SAs-MoS2... were evaluated... in Ar-saturated 1.0 M KOH with a typical three-electrode system... Tm SAs-MoS2-120 W exhibited best HER activity... shows a low overpotential of 80 mV at 10 mA cm−2 (ηj10)... Tafel slope... 82.6 mV dec−1... current density can be well maintained at ≈10 mA cm−2 for more than 27 h... experimental H2 yield almost coincides with the theoretical value, indicating the almost 100% Faradic efficiency...
